slot_scores.name: missing_objective
slot_scores.evidence_quote: What is the primary goal of this planning exercise: to minimize the total cost of the tables, to maximize the number of tables ordered, or to achieve some other specific target?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the optimization objective, including minimizing total cost versus other goals.

slot_scores.name: A_requires_min_B_tables
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask whether ordering from Supplier A requires at least 30 tables from Supplier B. The turn 2 question about per-supplier minimum/maximum order limits is a vague related question and does not target this conditional A-to-B rule.

slot_scores.name: B_requires_C_order
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask whether ordering from Supplier B requires also ordering from Supplier C. Its final model treats B and C as independent.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: There is no conditional requirement that ordering from Supplier A forces at least 30 tables from Supplier B; orders from A and B are independent.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about the A-to-B conditional constraint, and the user never confirmed it. The READY_TO_MODEL constraints omit any such linkage.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: There is no conditional requirement that ordering from Supplier B forces an order from Supplier C; orders from B and C are independent.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about the B-to-C conditional constraint, and the user never confirmed it. The READY_TO_MODEL constraints omit any such linkage.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent resolved the P0 objective slot but entered READY_TO_MODEL while the two P1 conditional business-rule slots remained unasked and unresolved.

summary: The agent correctly clarified the objective but stopped after only one other broad question, failing to recover the conditional Supplier A-to-B and B-to-C ordering constraints before modeling.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
